map.选择探伤方法，输入缺陷参数，依据GB/T 3323、GB/T 11345等标准评: Select a flaw-detection method, input defect parameters, and grade defects per GB/T 3323, GB/T 11345 and other standards
map.依据 GB/T 3323（射线）、GB/T 11345（超声焊缝）、GB/T 9: Per national standards GB/T 3323 (radiography), GB/T 11345 (ultrasonic weld), GB/T 9443 (penetrant), this tool grades quality from input method, defect length, base-metal thickness, etc.; the principle compares defect-size-to-thickness ratio against grade limits, output in real time. Fully client-side, data stays in browser.
map.按缺陷类型选择 X 光、超声或渗透探伤。: Choose X-ray, ultrasonic or penetrant testing by defect type.
map.评估各方法的适用材料与灵敏度。: Evaluate each method's suitable materials and sensitivity.
map.铸件内部缺陷优先用 X 光或超声；X 光成像直观，超声对大厚度件穿透力更强。: For internal casting defects prefer X-ray or ultrasound; X-ray gives intuitive imaging, ultrasound penetrates thicker parts better.
map.表面开口缺陷用渗透探伤灵敏、成本低；近表面缺陷可用磁粉（铁磁材料）。: Surface-breaking defects use penetrant testing, sensitive and low-cost; near-surface defects can use magnetic particle (ferromagnetic materials).
map.超声和射线哪个更好？: Which is better, ultrasound or radiography?
map.二者互补：射线适合体积型缺陷与成像，超声对面积型缺陷（裂纹、未熔合）更敏感。: They complement each other: radiography suits volumetric defects and imaging, ultrasound is more sensitive to planar defects (cracks, lack of fusion).
map.渗透探伤能查内部缺陷吗？: Can penetrant testing find internal defects?
map.不能。渗透只能检出表面开口缺陷，内部缺陷需用射线或超声。: No. Penetrant only finds surface-breaking defects; internal defects need radiography or ultrasound.
map.本工具依据GB/T 3323（射线）、GB/T 11345（超声）、JB/T 6: This tool grades defects per GB/T 3323 (radiography), GB/T 11345 (ultrasound) and JB/T 6062 (penetrant)
map.射线探伤按缺陷长度与板厚比分级；超声探伤按波幅当量和指示长度分级；渗透探伤按痕迹: Radiography grades by defect-length-to-thickness ratio; ultrasound grades by amplitude equivalent and indicated length; penetrant grades by indication size
map.Ⅰ级为最高质量等级，Ⅳ/Ⅴ级为不合格，需返修或报废: Grade I is the highest; Grade IV/V is unqualified, requiring repair or scrap
map.实际评定应结合评定区尺寸、缺陷间距和分布综合判断: Actual grading should combine evaluation-zone size, defect spacing and distribution
map.探伤人员应持有相应方法的特种设备无损检测人员资格证书: Flaw-detection personnel should hold the corresponding special-equipment NDT personnel qualification certificate
map.铸件无损探伤等级评定工具，支持射线(RT)、超声(UT)、渗透(PT)三种探伤方: Casting NDT grade-evaluation tool supporting RT, UT and PT; after inputting defect parameters it automatically grades quality per national standards.
map.如何使用检测（X光/超声/渗透）探伤: How to use Inspection (X-ray/Ultrasound/Penetrant) Flaw Detection
map.射线探伤（RT）等级评定：输入缺陷长度与母材厚度，对照 GB/T 3323 评定: RT grading: input defect length and base-metal thickness, grade cast-steel or weld quality per GB/T 3323 (Grade I-IV), output pass/fail and corrective suggestions; UT weld inspection: scan butt welds, grade indicated defect length and level per GB/T 11345, locating volumetric defects like lack of fusion and incomplete penetration.
